prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup, stylized-concept.
Create a NEW visual design proposal board for the home-screen recycling bins and beach litter sprites in a Japanese elementary-school pet game. The attached achievement-badge proposal is ONLY the STYLE REFERENCE. Match its cheerful rounded 2.5D painted volume, glossy soft white highlights, warm ivory edges, fine colored contours, bright aqua/coral/lemon colors and polished toy-like craftsmanship. Do not reproduce the achievement badges, dolphin characters, medals or title grid. This new board depicts exactly THREE sorting bins and SEVEN distinct litter items.
Game concept: an exploration team sorts litter on the beach and raises marine companion pets.
Composition: clean wide high-resolution landscape board on warm ivory background. Header exactly "たんけんたいの おそうじ道具". Subtitle exactly "ごみ箱・ごみ デザイン案". Three spacious equal vertical panels from left to right, very pale blue, pale yellow and pale coral respectively, softly rounded corners. Each panel contains ONE LARGE bin in its upper half, its Japanese category name below the bin, and the matching isolated litter sprites in its lower half with clear labels under each. Do not crowd. Make bins and litter beautiful and clearly readable, show entire silhouettes without overlap.
The three bins share a coordinated expedition-equipment design: sturdy squat rounded rectangular boxes, open top with a broad dark visible opening for dragging litter into, thick warm-ivory rounded lip, short rounded side handles, subtle base feet and a small wave-shaped accent along base. Gently three-quarter front view from slightly above. Bright glossy painted surface with modest pearly highlights, not photorealistic plastic. No lids covering openings, no faces/eyes, no pets standing in or on the bins. Large unmistakable HIGH CONTRAST WHITE PICTOGRAMS on front identify contents, readable at 58px wide. No complex badges or gold medal borders on the bins. Same physical size for all three. Label OUTSIDE under each bin in large rounded Japanese text; do not put paragraphs or tiny letters on objects.
LEFT BLUE PANEL:
Bin saturated sky/ocean BLUE body, ivory lip. Front has a big combined white BOTTLE + simple BAG pictogram. Category exact "プラスチック".
Below it exactly THREE isolated litter sprites in a row, with matching names:
"ペットボトル": slightly squashed translucent pale-blue PET drink bottle, blue screw cap, visible simple ribs and one soft dent, faint blue label band without text. Angled 25 degrees, distinct short capped neck.
"ビニールぶくろ": crumpled pale-blue translucent shopping bag with two loop handles, clear folds, an irregular collapsed bottom, readable bag outline.
"ロープ": small loose coil of BLUE synthetic rope, two short loose ends, simple twisted texture. A stray rope coil, not a bow or decorative gift ribbon.
MIDDLE GOLDEN YELLOW PANEL:
Bin warm sun-YELLOW / amber body, ivory lip. Front has TWO large white pictograms: a can AND a narrow-neck GLASS bottle. Category exact "かん・びん".
Below exactly TWO isolated litter sprites side by side:
"かん": gently dented silver beverage can with muted amber/yellow band, clear oval top and pull tab, simple dented outline; no brand or text.
"びん": intact clear amber-tinted GLASS bottle lying at 25 degrees, long open narrow neck with no plastic screw cap, round shoulders, thick rounded glass base and restrained glass highlights. Distinct from PET bottle, no shards or broken edges.
RIGHT CORAL PANEL:
Bin warm CORAL red-orange body, ivory lip. Front has TWO large white pictograms: a folded PAPER sheet and a small forked TWIG, not flames. Category exact "もえるゴミ".
Below exactly TWO isolated litter sprites side by side:
"きのえだ": natural warm brown Y-shaped short driftwood twig with rounded ends and a few restrained bark grooves, subtle warm coral shadows.
"かみくず": irregular crumpled ivory paper ball with several large legible folds and warm peach-coral shadows. Clearly crumpled paper, not a rock, popcorn or flower.
Litter style: same softly rounded polished painted 2.5D family as the reference badges, with obvious recognizable material and slight used/dented/rumpled details. Litter must remain simple at about54px display size. NO faces, eyes, smiles, gold rims, jeweled shine, sparkles or sticker outlines around litter. No decorative stars on trash. Soft tiny contact shadows only, each sprite separate.
Bottom footer exactly "色とマークを合わせて、たのしく分別！"
All Japanese text accurate and legible. No other bins or litter categories. No UI controls, progress bars, phone frames, watermark, new pet designs or unrelated illustrations. This is a proposal board only, not a full app screenshot.
